title: Smooth pullback cohomology and support dimension
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth morphism of constant relative dimension $d$ between separated schemes of finite type over a field $k$, and let $K$ be a bounded constructible $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-coefficient complex on $Y$ in the categories of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. For every integer $i$, derived pullback is exact on the cohomology sheaves and there is a canonical identification $\mathcal H^{-i}(Lf^*K[d])\cong f^*\mathcal H^{-i+d}(K)$. Consequently, with supports and their dimensions as in [def-per-support-condition], $$\dim\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal H^{-i}(Lf^*K[d])\le \dim\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal H^{-i+d}(K)+d.$$
